author: CNN
description:
The United States announced it had completed its withdrawal from Iraq on Wednesday, more than 20 years after invading the country to topple Saddam Hussein, in a move that was celebrated by the Iraqi government and the Pentagon – as well as Iran and its allies, who claim years of pressure forced the American departure.

In 2024, the Iraqi government and the Biden administration agreed to a phased withdrawal of US troops, a plan the Trump administration has honored. The pullout, however, leaves a new Iraqi government with the daunting task of loosening Iran’s grip on its neighbor, which has long been trapped in a cycle of sectarianism, foreign meddling and civil conflict.

description:
"The ideological clowns are out. The patriotic cowboys are in, with testosterone testing on top," said Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in his "State of the Force" address Wednesday. Hegseth also announced a 20% cut to the US military's generals and admirals - approximately 170 general and admiral officer slots -  by January 1. This target is double the percentage target for cutting general and flag officer positions, up from a 10% reduction of generals and admirals he had directed in a May 2025 memo.

Retired Army Brig. Gen. Ty Seidule reacts to Hegseth's plan, saying that Hegseth is "controlling the next generation of military leaders to be political." Retired Air Force Col. Cedric Leighton and retired Army Lt. Gen. Karen Gibson also unpack the changes promised in Hegseth's speech.

author: CNN
description:
Gulf oil producers, with considerable support from the US Navy, are jamming crude through the Strait of Hormuz, right under Iran’s nose. Oil and petroleum product flows through the critical chokepoint averaged 13.1 million barrels per day last week, according to Kpler, a marine data tracking service.

That’s just under 80% of the 17.1 million barrels that had traveled through the strait each day before the war broke out. “Given such a strong volume passing through the strait, it is clear Iran is losing its influence over it,” said Matt Smith, director of commodity research at Kpler.

CNN takes a look what recent developments in the Strait mean for the war and check in on where talks between the US and Iran stand.

author: CNN
description:
Reports of comments made by Jane Doe to Cornell University police in 2024 when she first went to school officials with allegations she was gang raped are raising new questions about what law enforcement knew at the time. 

Doe told police she was okay with an initial encounter, but that later in the night she did not consent and believed she was raped. She also described being physically hit.

The revelations raise new questions as to why law enforcement did not file criminal charges at the time of the incident and what the district attorney’s office was aware of regarding the assault allegations, as calls grow for answers in light of Doe’s civil lawsuit filed this month. In a statement to CNN, Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten said his office was not provided the transcript of Doe's police interview and “will be investigating this fully and determining the truth.”

CNN legal analyst Elliot Williams unpacks the new questions, and CNN's Sara Sidner speaks with defens
title: Cornell rape investigation: DA, defense attorney, legal expert weigh in

description:
A “violent incident” between two pilots caused a Flydubai aircraft traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv to divert to Saudi Arabia, sources have told CNN. An Israeli official said the incident was not a hijacking and the plane has now landed. 

The aircraft descended 17,400 feet in just over two minutes at around 1:20 a.m. ET, flight tracking data shows. The incident prompted Israel’s prime minister and defense minister to hold a security consultation. Israeli fighter jets were launched after the emergency signal was sent, a military spokesperson said. 

CNN's Jeremy Diamond has the details and CNN transportation analyst Mary Schiavo reacts to news of a scuffle in the cockpit.

Smith’s testimony comes as Republicans continue to probe the investigations into Trump and as some in the party, including the president, have pushed for often-unspecified criminal charges to be brought against Smith.
